description: YHPrimer-1000 is a two-component, water-based, rigid epoxy primer with both penetrative sealing and surface-leveling effects. It is designed to enhance the adhesion of polyurethane waterproof coatings with substrates and block micro-voids in porous substrates to mitigate out-gassing. It can be diluted with water to a suitable viscosity according to the actual condition of the substrate.
whereToUse: YHPrimer-1000 is suitable for concrete surfaces
compatible with moisture-cured and chemically-cured polyurethane waterproof membranes, and water-based coatings, except for two-component hot spray polyurea
designed to enhance the adhesion of polyurethane waterproofing systems on mortar, concrete, or ceramic substrates
notFor: except for two-component hot spray polyurea
For damp mortar, concrete, or ceramic substrates, ensure that there is no standing water on the surface
It is not recommended to break down the kits into smaller quantities
Be aware of the out-gassing effect on porous substrates when the temperature rises

It is highly recommended to apply the next coating product within 24 hours after the primer becomes tack-free. A longer gap between the primer and the next coating product may result in deteriorated interface adhesion and failure
Do not store the product above 40°C

standards.value: Pull-off adhesion strength on damp concrete ≥ 2.0 MPa

technicalData.label: Volume nonvolatile matter, by volume (ASTM D2697)
Pull-off adhesion strength on damp concrete (ASTM D7234)
Dilution
technicalData.value: The primer can be diluted with 100-300% water by weight

technicalData.label: Coverage per set, m², diluted 1:1 (YHPrimer-1000 : water)
Tack-free time
technicalData.value: about 6 hours for the primer to become tack-free at 25°C (when diluted 3 times with water)

consumption.quote: Considering a homogeneous substrate, the consumption rate is approximately 0.15-0.25kg/m²
The dilution rate depends on substrate conditions: the more porous substrates and higher moisture contents requires a low dilution rate. The coverage varies with the dilution rate.

mixing: The mix ratio is 5:3 (Part A: Part B) by weight. Add Part B into Part A and mix with a low-speed mechanical mixer at low speed for at least 2 minutes.
packaging: Part A: 10 kg/pail; Part B: 6 kg/pail
storage: The recommended storage temperature range is 5°C to 35°C. Do not store the product above 40°C. The shelf life is 12 months under the recommended storage conditions.
